title: LTP: Use sub-dissector for client service handling
description:
This guards against recursion for client service ID 2.
This warns if multiple PDUs are present in the block for client service ID 1.

Closes #20853

commits_data.title: LTP: Use dissector table for client service handling
commits_data.message:
LTP: Use dissector table for client service handling

The table name is "ltp.client_service" with uint32 keys.
This guards against recursion for client service ID 2.
This warns if multiple PDUs are present in the block for client service ID 1.
